title: Xdrip+ cant connect with Limitter. Android 9.0
body:
Updated to 9.0 version yesterday(android, LG G6), latest xdrip build of 24th of September doesn't work, as well as other random versions (tried a few down to 2018 builds).
Pretty much stuck at receiving data from LimiTTer collector.

Thanks!

comments.body: Me too, its happening every day.

> Me too, its happening every day.

So it's not only me.. Was starting to think my miaomiao died or something
What phone you have? What troubleshooting have you tried so far?

Pretty much same what you've tried. I resetted the MiaoMiao through the button on the transmitter, need to wait to charge and see if it works this way, otherwise will perform a factory reset for my phone to roll back on old android version (probably will be 7.0 or something)

Hopefully this will help until a fix is out

Good luck :)

Have you tried playing around with the `Use Scanning` and `Trust Auto-Connect` advanced bluetooth settings in xDrip settings? Use the search to find them. Make sure you're also running the latest xDrip+ nightly version.

I've just performed a factory reset and it looks like it did the trick, though it chose Tomato as the, instead of LimiTTer. This is on the latest nightly version.

Hope it helps anyone else who has this issue

You can always backup your files through your phone or on your pc/laptop
Google some guides, there are some easy ones out there how to backup your data for a factory reset

Good luck 😊

@NovaProspekt7 Would you please close this issue as it seems it was resolved?
Thanks
